Class bayesnecgroupfit of models fitted separately at each level of a factor

Source: R/bayesnecgroupfit-class.R
bayesnecgroupfit-class.Rd

Returned by bnec_group. Each element of fits is an ordinary bayesnecfit or bayesmanecfit, so everything that works on those works per level.

Details

See methods(class = "bayesnecgroupfit") for an overview of available methods.

Slots

fits

A named list of fits, one per level.

group_var

The name of the grouping column.

levels

The factor levels, in order.

formula

The bayesnecformula fitted at every level.

data

The full data.frame, all levels.

family

The family, chosen once and shared by every level.

n

The number of observations per level.

See also

bnec_group, crossed_group_weights, bayesnecfit, bayesmanecfit
